يجن (form I)
# يَجُنُّ (yajunnu) /ja.d͡ʒun.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of جَنَّ (janna)
# يُجَنُّ (yujannu) /ju.d͡ʒan.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
# يَجُنَّ (yajunna) /ja.d͡ʒun.na/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of جَنَّ (janna)
# يُجَنَّ (yujanna) /ju.d͡
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
